Vault locations are managed by a wiki admin.
Typ umístění musí být složka spravovaná: The location type must be a folder managed by Atlas, a local folder, or an SMB network folder.
Uživatelské jméno a doména smí mít nejvý: The username and domain can have at most 200 characters.
Složka trezorů nesmí ležet v publikované: The vault folder must not be in the published wiki content (wwwroot), from where files could be downloaded.
The search text can have at most 200 characters.
Soubor s tímto názvem už v umístění exis: A file with this name already exists in the location. Attach it as an existing vault.
Název souboru musí být jeden název bez l: The file name must be a single name without slashes and forbidden characters.
A vault file must have the extension .kdbx.
Tento soubor už je v Atlasu připojený ja: This file is already connected to Atlas as a vault.
Trezor s tímto názvem v prostoru už exis: A vault with this name already exists in the space.
Druh události musí být release, request: The event kind must be release, request or grant.
Umístění používají trezory. Nejdříve je: The location is used by vaults. Archive them first.
Tento soubor nebo název trezoru mezitím: Another admin has registered this file or vault name in the meantime.
A location with this name already exists.
Přístup nelze udělit vyšší ani na dobu d: Access cannot be granted at a higher level or for longer than your own permission to manage the vault or password.
Vyberte úroveň přístupu: discover (vidí): Choose an access level: discover (sees), read (reads) or manage.
Trezory spravuje správce wiki nebo správ: Vaults are managed by a wiki admin or a space admin.
Vyberte pole userName, password, url neb: Choose the field userName, password, url or notes.
The operation must be reveal or copy.
Příliš mnoho požadavků na zobrazení hese: Too many requests to show passwords. Try again in a moment.
Záznam v souboru trezoru už není. Počkej: The entry is no longer in the vault file. Wait for the vault to refresh.
Trezor je zamčený; správce musí zadat hl: The vault is locked; an admin must enter the master password again.
Trezor teď není dostupný. Zkuste to pozd: The vault is not available right now. Try again later.
The vault file cannot be read.
K zobrazení hesla potřebujete oprávnění: To show the password, you need permission to read it. You can request it.
The selected fields of the entry are empty.
A note can have at most 500 characters.
Žádost už čeká na vyřízení. Obnovte strá: The request is already waiting to be handled. Refresh the page.
The request has already been handled.
Only read access (level read) can be requested.
Uveďte důvod žádosti (nejvýše 500 znaků): State the reason for the request (at most 500 characters).
The status filter must be pending or all.
Zadejte hlavní heslo databáze KeePass (n: Enter the master password of the KeePass database (at most 1024 characters).
Hlavní heslo nového trezoru musí mít {mi: The master password of a new vault must have {minimumNewLength} to {maximumLength} characters.
Trezor nebyl nalezen nebo ho nemůžete sp: The vault was not found, or you cannot manage it.
K této operaci potřebujete oprávnění spr: You need permission to manage the vault or password for this operation.
K této operaci potřebujete oprávnění čís: You need permission to read the password for this operation.
Dokument odkazuje na heslo, které v Atla: The document links to a password that you cannot use in Atlas.
Stránka obsahuje obsah, ke kterému nemát: The page contains content you have no access to. You can read it, but not edit it.
You can already read the vault.
You can already read the password.
Heslo k trezoru není uložené nebo ho ser: The vault password is not stored, or the server can no longer decrypt it. Enter the master password again.
Uložené heslo už soubor neotevře; hlavní: The stored password no longer opens the file; the master password was probably changed in KeePass. Enter the current master password.
Heslo tento soubor neotevře. Podporované: The password does not open this file. Only a master password is supported; a database with a key file or a Windows account cannot be opened.
Soubor je poškozený, neúplný nebo to nen: The file is corrupted, incomplete or not a KeePass database.
Soubor používá formát nebo ochranu, kter: The file uses a format or protection that Atlas does not read (KDBX 3.1, key file, Twofish). Save it in KeePass 2.35 or newer as KDBX 4 protected only by a master password.
Soubor překračuje povolené limity trezor: The file exceeds the allowed vault limits (size, number of entries or key derivation cost).
The vault file was not found in the location.
Umístění trezoru není dostupné. Zkontrol: The vault location is not available. Check the network connection, the shared folder and the location's credentials.
Heslo umístění nelze dešifrovat. Zadejte: The location password cannot be decrypted. Enter it again in the location settings.
Zadejte absolutní místní složku serveru,: Enter an absolute local server folder, or an address smb://server/share/folder. Credentials belong in separate fields; UNC paths and custom SMB ports are not supported.
